His friend Gerda traveled far to rescue him. She faced many dangers with pure courage. Her warm tears melted the splinter in Kays heart. The spell broke and they returned home. Love conquered the Snow Queens ice.

title: Jack and the Beanstalk
content: Jack traded his cow for magic beans. His mother threw them out the window. A giant beanstalk grew overnight. Jack climbed it and found a giants castle. He stole a bag of gold, a hen that laid golden eggs, and a magic harp. The giant chased him down the beanstalk. Jack chopped the beanstalk down. The giant fell and was never seen again.

title: Rapunzel
content: A witch locked Rapunzel in a tower with no stairs. The witch climbed by calling Rapunzel let down your hair. A prince heard Rapunzel singing and discovered the secret. He visited her and they fell in love. The witch discovered them and cut Rapunzels hair. The prince was blinded and wandered. Rapunzels tears healed his eyes. They returned to the kingdom and married.

title: The Frog Prince
content: A princess dropped her golden ball into a pond. A frog offered to retrieve it if she promised to be his friend. The princess agreed but ran away after getting her ball. The frog followed her to the castle. The king made her keep her promise. She kissed the frog and he turned into a handsome prince. He had been cursed by a witch. They married and lived happily.

title: The Tortoise and the Hare
content: A hare mocked a tortoise for being slow. The tortoise challenged the hare to a race. The hare ran fast then stopped to rest. He fell asleep. The tortoise kept moving slowly but steadily. The hare woke up and saw the tortoise near the finish line. He ran but could not catch up. The tortoise won. Slow and steady wins the race.

title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
content: All summer a grasshopper played while ants stored food. When winter came the grasshopper had nothing. He asked the ants for food. The ants asked what he did all summer. He said he was too busy singing and dancing. The ants replied since you sang all summer you can dance all winter. The grasshopper learned to prepare for the future.

title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
content: A shepherd boy repeatedly tricked villagers by yelling wolf when there was no wolf. The villagers came running each time but found no wolf. They grew tired of his lies. One day a real wolf came. The boy cried wolf but no one came. The wolf ate his sheep. Liars are not believed even when they tell the truth.

title: The Lion and the Mouse
content: A lion caught a tiny mouse but let it go. The mouse promised to help the lion someday. The lion laughed how could a mouse help a king of beasts? Later the lion was caught in a hunters net. The mouse heard his roars and chewed through the rope. The lion was free. Even the smallest friend can be a great help.

title: The Fox and the Grapes
content: A hungry fox saw juicy grapes hanging from a vine. He jumped but could not reach them. He tried again and again. Finally he gave up and said those grapes are probably sour anyway. Sometimes people pretend they do not want things they cannot have.

title: The Crow and the Pitcher
content: A thirsty crow found a pitcher with water at the bottom. His beak could not reach the water. He dropped pebbles into the pitcher one by one. The water level rose until he could drink. Little by little does the trick. Persistence and creativity solve problems.

title: The Wind and the Sun
content: The wind and the sun argued who was stronger. They saw a traveler and challenged each other to make him remove his coat. The wind blew hard but the traveler held his coat tighter. The sun shone warmly. The traveler felt hot and removed his coat. Kindness and gentleness are stronger than force.

title: The Fox and the Stork
content: The fox invited the stork for dinner. He served soup in flat plates. The storks long beak could not eat. The stork invited the fox next day. She served food in tall narrow jars. The fox could not reach. The stork said do not play tricks if you cannot take them yourself.

title: Treasure Island Summary
content: Young Jim Hawkins found a pirates treasure map. He joined a ship to find the treasure. The crew included the one-legged Long John Silver. There was mutiny and adventure on the island. Jim bravely fought pirates and found the treasure. He returned home rich and wiser.

title: Robinson Crusoe
content: Robinson Crusoe was shipwrecked on a deserted island. He built shelter, found food, and made tools. He lived alone for many years. He rescued a native man named Friday. He taught Friday English and they became friends. After 28 years they were rescued.

title: Jules Vernes Around the World in 80 Days
content: Phileas Fogg bet he could travel around the world in 80 days. He and his servant Passepartout faced many obstacles. They rode trains, ships, and elephants. Detective Fix pursued them thinking Fogg was a bank robber. They returned to London just in time winning the bet.

title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
content: Tom Sawyer was a mischievous boy from Missouri. He tricked friends into whitewashing a fence. He fell in love with Becky Thatcher. He witnessed a murder and testified in court. He found hidden treasure with Huckleberry Finn. Tom became a hero in his town.

title: The Jungle Book
content: Mowgli was a human boy raised by wolves in the Indian jungle. Baloo the bear taught him the law of the jungle. Bagheera the panther protected him. Shere Khan the tiger hunted him. Mowgli defeated Shere Khan with fire and later rejoined human society.

title: Alice in Wonderland
content: Alice followed a white rabbit down a hole into a strange world. She grew and shrank by eating and drinking. She met the Mad Hatter, the Cheshire Cat, and the Queen of Hearts. The queen shouted Off with her head! Alice stood up to her. She woke up realizing it was all a dream.

title: Peter Pan
content: Peter Pan was a boy who never grew up. He lived in Neverland with the Lost Boys. He brought Wendy and her brothers to Neverland. They fought Captain Hook and his pirates. Tinker Bell the fairy saved Peters life. Wendy returned home but Peter stayed young forever.

title: The Wizard of Oz
content: Dorothy was swept to Oz by a tornado. She followed the yellow brick road to the Emerald City. She made friends: Scarecrow who wanted a brain, Tin Man who wanted a heart, and Cowardly Lion who wanted courage. The Wizard sent them to kill the Wicked Witch. Dorothy clicked her ruby slippers and returned to Kansas.

title: The Pyramids of Egypt
content: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built around 2560 BC. It was the tallest building in the world for 3800 years. It was made of about 2.3 million stone blocks. Each block weighed about 2.5 tons. The pyramid was a tomb for Pharaoh Khufu. It took about 20 years to build.

title: The Great Wall of China
content: The Great Wall of China is over 21,000 kilometers long. It was built over many dynasties starting in the 7th century BC. It protected China from northern invaders. Watchtowers along the wall sent signals. The wall was built by soldiers and workers. It is a UNESCO World Heritage site.

title: The Amazon Rainforest
content: The Amazon is the worlds largest rainforest covering 5.5 million square kilometers. It spans 9 countries mostly Brazil. It produces 20% of the worlds oxygen. It is home to millions of plant and animal species. Many medicines come from Amazon plants. Deforestation threatens this precious ecosystem.

title: The Northern Lights
content: Aurora Borealis or Northern Lights are colorful lights in the night sky. They occur near the North Pole. Solar particles hit Earths atmosphere. Green, red, and purple lights dance across the sky. Best viewed in Norway, Sweden, Finland, Canada, and Alaska.

title: The Olympic Games
content: The Olympics began in ancient Greece around 776 BC. Athletes competed in running, wrestling, and chariot racing. The modern Olympics started in 1896 in Athens. The five rings represent the five continents. The games bring the world together every two years.

title: The Great Barrier Reef
content: The Great Barrier Reef is the largest coral reef system. It stretches over 2,300 kilometers off Australias coast. It has over 1,500 fish species and 400 coral types. It is visible from space. Climate change threatens coral with bleaching.

title: The Sahara Desert
content: The Sahara is the largest hot desert covering 9.2 million square kilometers. It spans 11 African countries. Temperatures can reach 50°C during the day. At night it can drop to freezing. Camels are called ships of the desert and can go weeks without water.

title: The Taj Mahal
content: The Taj Mahal in India was built by Emperor Shah Jahan for his wife Mumtaz Mahal. It took 22 years and 20,000 workers to build. White marble changes color throughout the day. It is considered one of the most beautiful buildings in the world.

title: Machu Picchu
content: Machu Picchu is an Inca city in Peru at 2,430 meters high. It was built around 1450 and abandoned 100 years later. Spanish conquerors never found it. It was rediscovered in 1911 by Hiram Bingham. Stones fit together perfectly without mortar.

title: Mount Everest
content: Mount Everest is the worlds tallest mountain at 8,849 meters. It is in the Himalayas between Nepal and Tibet. Sir Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay first reached the summit in 1953. Climbing needs months of preparation. The death zone above 8,000 meters is extremely dangerous.

title: The Monkey King
content: Sun Wukong the Monkey King was born from a stone. He learned magic and became incredibly powerful. He stole peaches of immortality from heaven. Heaven sent armies to capture him but he defeated them. Buddha trapped him under a mountain for 500 years. He later protected the monk Xuanzang on the Journey to the West.

title: Mulan
content: Mulan was a brave Chinese girl. When her aged father was called to war she cut her hair and disguised herself as a man. She fought for twelve years without anyone discovering she was a woman. She became a great warrior. After the war she returned home and revealed her identity. Her family was proud of her courage.

title: The Legend of the White Snake
content: A white snake spirit named Bai Suzhen transformed into a beautiful woman. She married a scholar named Xu Xian. A Buddhist monk named Fahai discovered she was a snake spirit. He trapped her in a pagoda. Her sister spirit and her son rescued her. Their love conquered all obstacles.

title: The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl
content: A cowherd named Niulang fell in love with Zhinu a weaving fairy. They married and had children. The Queen of Heaven separated them with the Milky Way. Once a year on the 7th day of the 7th lunar month magpies form a bridge. The lovers meet for one night. This is the Qixi Festival.

title: The Butterfly Lovers
content: Zhu Yingtai disguised herself as a man to study. She fell in love with her classmate Liang Shanbo. They studied together for three years. Liang discovered her true identity too late. She was forced to marry another man. They died and transformed into butterflies flying together forever.

title: Nezha Conquers the Dragon King
content: Nezha was born from a lotus flower with great powers. He fought the Dragon King who terrorized people. He used his magical Wind Fire Wheels and the Universe Ring. He sacrificed himself to save his family. His master resurrected him with a lotus body. He became a protective deity.

title: Kua Fu Chases the Sun
content: Kua Fu was a giant who wanted to catch the sun. He ran after the sun across mountains and rivers. He became very thirsty and drank all the water from the Yellow River and the Wei River. He still was not satisfied. He died of thirst on the way. His staff became a peach forest.

title: The Magic Paintbrush
content: Ma Liang was a poor boy who loved painting. An old man gave him a magic paintbrush. Whatever he painted became real. He painted food for the hungry and tools for farmers. A greedy official tried to steal the brush. Ma Liang painted a ship then painted a storm. The official drowned.

title: The Dragon Boat Festival Story
content: Qu Yuan was a patriotic poet of ancient China. The king did not listen to his advice. Qu Yuan drowned himself in the Miluo River. People threw rice dumplings into the river to feed the fish so they would not eat his body. They also raced dragon boats to search for him. This is how Dragon Boat Festival began.

title: Hou Yi Shoots the Suns
content: Long ago ten suns rose in the sky together. The earth became too hot. Crops died and people suffered. Hou Yi a great archer shot down nine suns with his bow. Only one sun remained. The people thanked him. His wife Chang Er later flew to the moon. This is the Mid-Autumn Festival story.

title: How Dinosaurs Lived
content: Dinosaurs lived on Earth for about 165 million years. They came in all sizes: from chicken-sized to 30 meters long. T-Rex was one of the largest meat-eaters. Triceratops had three horns for defense. Brachiosaurus was so tall it could look over a four-story building. Dinosaurs went extinct 65 million years ago probably from an asteroid.

title: The Water Cycle
content: Water moves in a continuous cycle. The sun heats water in oceans and lakes. Water evaporates into vapor. Vapor rises and cools forming clouds. Clouds release rain or snow. Water returns to rivers and oceans. The cycle repeats forever. All water on Earth has been cycling for billions of years.

title: Why the Sky is Blue
content: Sunlight looks white but contains all colors. When sunlight reaches Earths atmosphere it scatters off gas molecules. Blue light scatters more than other colors because it travels in shorter smaller waves. Our eyes see the scattered blue light from all directions. At sunset light passes through more atmosphere so we see red and orange.

title: The Solar System
content: Our solar system has eight planets orbiting the sun. Mercury is closest to the sun. Venus is the hottest. Earth is the only known planet with life. Mars is the red planet. Jupiter is the biggest. Saturn has beautiful rings. Uranus spins on its side. Neptune is the farthest and windiest.

title: How Seeds Grow
content: A seed contains a tiny baby plant inside. When a seed gets water, air, and warmth it starts to grow. First a root grows down into the soil. Then a stem grows up toward the sun. Leaves open to make food. Flowers appear. New seeds form. The cycle of life continues.

title: The Human Heart
content: The heart is a powerful muscle about the size of a fist. It beats about 100,000 times every day. It pumps blood through 96,000 kilometers of blood vessels. Blood carries oxygen and nutrients to every cell. The heart works without rest your whole life. Exercise makes your heart stronger and healthier.

title: Volcanoes
content: A volcano is a mountain that opens to melted rock below. Magma is hot liquid rock underground. When magma erupts it is called lava. Lava can reach 1,200°C. Some volcanoes erupt explosively. Others have slow flowing lava. Volcanic soil is very fertile for farming.

title: The Ocean Floor
content: The ocean floor has mountains deeper than any on land. The Mariana Trench is the deepest place on Earth at 11 kilometers down. Underwater volcanoes create new land. Hydrothermal vents spew superheated water. Strange creatures live in complete darkness. We have mapped less of the ocean floor than the surface of Mars.
